module_summary: Byte-stream packet framer: a 4-state FSM syncs on in[3] to count three bytes while a 24-bit shift register captures them, output when done.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: 4-state framing FSM BYTE1/BYTE2/BYTE3/DONE tracking message byte position

anchors.name: out_bytes_r
anchors.why: 24-bit shift register shifting in each input byte

anchors.name: done
anchors.why: Decoded from DONE state; validates out_bytes for one cycle per message

anchors.name: out_bytes
anchors.why: 24-bit received message output, gated by done

anchors.name: in
anchors.why: Input byte stream shifted into out_bytes_r

anchors.name: in3
anchors.why: Bit 3 of input byte; marks first byte, steers FSM transitions

groups.name: Framing FSM
groups.description: Detects message start via in[3] and counts three bytes, asserting done

groups.name: Byte shift register
groups.description: Shifts input bytes into 24-bit register, output as out_bytes when done
